author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Rejected drawing was a squat 45-degree bolt with a lopsided arrowhead (one barb large, one missing) that read as a boot; redrawn as the reference's tall outlined bolt on 1:2 bands with a symmetric arrowhead of 9-unit barbs, both blades and steps 8+ apart. Checked 48px light/dark.
omissions: Arrow axis steeper than the reference (down, slightly left) so the head fits the 40-unit height with symmetric barbs.
